description_en: Queries snapshot chains of disks. A snapshot chain consists of all snapshots of a disk. Each disk corresponds to one snapshot chain
description_zh: 查询云盘快照链。快照链是一块云盘所有快照组成的关系链，一块云盘对应一条快照链
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-snapshot-links --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-bp1h6jmbefj2cyqs0000 --disk-ids 'd-bp1d6tsvznfghy7y0000_,_d-bp1ippxbaql9zet70000_,_…_d-bp1ib7bcz07lcxa90000' --snapshot-link-ids 'sl-bp1grgphbcc9brb50000_,_sl-bp1c4izumvq0i5bs0000_,_…_sl-bp1akk7isz866dds0000' --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSnapshotLinks

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the disk. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 云盘所属于的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The disk IDs. You can specify up to 100 disk IDs at a time. The DiskIds parameter is a JSON array. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 云盘ID。一次最多指定100个云盘ID。DiskIds参数取值格式为JSON数组，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
parameters.name: disk_ids

parameters.help_en: The snapshot chain IDs. You can specify up to 100 snapshot chain IDs at a time. The SnapshotLinkIds parameter is a JSON array. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 快照链ID。一次最多指定100个快照ID。SnapshotLinkIds参数取值格式为JSON数组，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
parameters.name: snapshot_link_ids

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the disk status list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
云盘状态列表的页码。起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。取值范围：1~100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100.
Default value:
If this parameter is not specified or is set to a value less than 10, the default value is 10.
If this parameter is set to a value greater than 100, the default value is 100
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。最大值为 100。
默认值：
当不设置值或设置的值小于 10 时，默认值为 10。
当设置的值大于 100 时，默认值为 100
parameters.name: max_results

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token returned in this call
NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证值

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the snapshot chain list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page as specified in the request
PageSize.description_zh: 输入时设置的每页行数

SnapshotLink.description_en: The collection of snapshot chain information
SnapshotLink.description_zh: 快照链信息组成的集合

Category.description_en:
The type of the snapshot chain. Valid values:

standard: standard snapshot chain.
archive: archive snapshot chain.
flash: instant access snapshot chain
Category.description_zh:
快照链类型。可能值：

standard: 标准快照链。
archive: 归档快照链。
flash: 极速可用快照链

InstantAccess.description_en:
Indicates whether the snapshot instant access feature is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled. Only enterprise SSDs (ESSDs) support this feature.
false: Disabled. The snapshot is a standard snapshot without the snapshot instant access feature enabled.

This parameter is deprecated. Standard snapshots of enterprise SSDs have been upgraded to [instant access by default]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193667.html）. No additional configuration or cost is required
InstantAccess.description_zh:
是否开启了快照极速可用功能。可能值：

true：开启。仅ESSD云盘支持开启该功能。
false：关闭。即快照为未开启快照极速可用功能的标准快照。

该参数已弃用。ESSD云盘标准快照已升级为[默认极速可用]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193667.html），您无需额外配置，且不产生额外花销

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the source disk of the snapshot chain
RegionId.description_zh: 快照链源云盘所属地域ID

SourceDiskId.description_en: The source disk ID. This field is retained even if the source disk of the snapshot has been deleted
SourceDiskId.description_zh: 源云盘ID，如果快照的源云盘已经被删除，该字段仍旧保留

SourceDiskName.description_en: The name of the source disk

SourceDiskSize.description_en: The capacity of the source disk. Unit: GiB

SourceDiskType.description_en:
The type of the source disk. Valid values:

system: system disk.
data: data disk
SourceDiskType.description_zh:
源云盘的云盘类型。可能值：

system：系统盘。
data：数据盘

TotalSize.description_en: The total size of all snapshots in the snapshot chain. Unit: bytes
TotalSize.description_zh: 快照链中所有快照的大小，单位：Byte

TotalCount.description_en:
The total number of snapshot chains.
When you use the `MaxResults` and `NextToken` parameters for a paged query, the returned `TotalCount` value is invalid. For paging, use `NextToken` and `MaxResults` instead
TotalCount.description_zh:
快照链总个数。
使用`MaxResults`和`NextToken`参数进行分页查询时，返回的`TotalCount`参数值无效
